title: Mage-OS Workflow Template Envelope
description: A gallery template: a thin envelope over the export format. `workflow` carries the export envelope's FIELDS but is NOT itself a valid export envelope (it omits the `format` tag); TemplateInstaller lifts it into a synthetic `mageos-workflow-export/1` envelope before handing it to the shared import path. Never contains secret values.

code.description: Stable machine identifier, kebab-case; unique across a source

version.description: Semantic version of the template content

workflow.description: The export envelope's fields, minus the `format` tag. Property schemas are $ref'd from the export schema so the two lineages cannot drift.

localizedText.description: Either a plain string or a {locale: string} map. `minProperties: 1` guarantees at least one entry; that the install locale (or a designated default) is present is RUNTIME validation JSON Schema cannot express, surfaced as a typed compatibility reason.

schema.description: Minimum definition schema version the engine must support

key.description: Substituted into the workflow body as %param.<key>%

note.description: Authored help text shown under the field; replaces the widget-derived note

type.description: Closed type set driving the install form widget and the server-side value validation. `string` = free text; `number` = numeric, range-checked against `min`/`max`; `url` = absolute http/https URL; `duration` = ISO-8601 interval (e.g. PT4H, P3D), rendered as a composite with an ISO escape hatch; `select` = pick from the declared `options`; `secret` = names a secret, the value is supplied at install time and never stored in the template. An `entity:<alias>` type resolves through the server-side entity option-source registry (MageOS\Workflows\Model\Option\EntityOptionSourceRegistry), which maps the alias to a registered option source (e.g. entity:salesrule -> cart_price_rules) and decides whether the widget is a bounded select or a searchable picker; the submitted value is existence-checked against that source when it is registered.

min.description: Lower bound for a `number` parameter; enforced server-side on every install path (admin, REST, CLI)

max.description: Upper bound for a `number` parameter; enforced server-side on every install path (admin, REST, CLI)

step.description: Client-side granularity hint for a `number` parameter's input (e.g. 1 for whole units); never enforced server-side

options.description: Inline options for a bounded source (F6 option-source union). Highest precedence: inline `options` win over `options_search`, which in turn wins over an `entity:*` type's registry mapping

options_search.description: Search reference for a large source (F6 option-source union); resolved by the meta/options endpoint (plan 07). Middle precedence: used when no inline `options` are declared, and it overrides an `entity:*` type's registry mapping
